title: Torchbearer content pack
description: The contract every pack loaded by Projects/torchbearer.html is validated against. Prose for all of it is in Projects/torchbearer/content-authoring-guide.md; the enforcement is Validator in Projects/torchbearer/js/registry.js, which reads the required lists below. Unknown fields are ignored by the engine rather than rejected, so this document is the only place that says which keys are actually read.

packMeta.description: Pack metadata. The only required top-level key.

id.description: Global id. Loading a pack whose id is already loaded is allowed; ids inside it replace what they collide with.

name.description: Shown on the load confirmation and the Shelf.

type.description: "content" or "adventure". Informational; a pack may carry both kinds of material.

description.description: One line shown on the load confirmation and the Shelf.

ancestry.description: An ancestry, with at least one heritage.

senses.description: darkvision and low-light vision display with an icon; others are text.

desc.description: One or two sentences of flavor.

boosts.description: boosts[0] is the two-way choice; ["free"] in slot 1 is the free boost.

feat.description: A skill feat id that exists once this pack loads.

keyAbility.description: One or more attribute keys the player picks between.

saves.description: Ranks for fort, ref and will.

attacks.description: Weapon proficiency ranks. attacks.martial also takes "partial" — the rogueOk list.

skillCount.description: Base trained skills, before Int and extras.

trainedSkills.description: A skill id, or an array of ids for a +1 pick.

label.description: What the choice is called, e.g. Way or Doctrine.

features.description: Display-only unless they carry effects or a special.

featLevels.description: Levels this class gains a feat of each kind, authoritative up to its highest entry.

skillIncreases.description: Levels this class gains a skill increase. Defaults to the standard row.

spellcasting.description: Omit or null for a martial class.

tradition.description: arcane, divine, occult, primal, or patron.

slots.description: Castable slots per rank at level 3. rules.js moves the row at other levels.

repertoire.description: Spontaneous only: spells known per rank.

grantCantrips.description: Auto-known cantrips, on top of the picks.

classFeature.description: A class feature, live once the hero's level reaches its own.

special.description: An engine hook id from guide §8.

classes.description: Required when type is class. A shared feat lists several.

level.description: The level slot that can take it.

prereq.description: prereq.skill is the only enforced form.

spell.description: A spell. Exactly one resolution model per spell — see guide §7.

traits.description: Also read by save bonuses carrying a matching vs.

hex.description: Free to cast, one per turn. Implies focus.

maxTargets.description: Extra nearest targets included, blazing-bolt style.

save.description: reflex, fortitude or will, vs the caster DC.

healOrHarmUndead.description: The heal pattern: damages undead on a Fort save.

livingOnly.description: The void pattern: only the living are damaged.

healsUndead.description: The void pattern: undead in the area are healed.

utility.description: No mechanical resolution; the Chronicle prints the description.

special.description: stabilize is the one implemented odd duck.

rankEffects.description: Keys are castable ranks. The engine uses the highest key ≤ the rank cast.

rankEffect.description: What the spell does when cast at this rank.

item.description: A weapon, armor, shield or consumable.

category.description: weapon, armor, shield, consumable or gear.

level.description: The item's level. Printed on the shop card.

price.description: Written the way the Player Core prints it: "12 gp", "1 gp, 5 sp". A bare number is rejected — twelve gold and twelve copper differ by a hundred. No price means it cannot be bought or sold.

prof.description: simple, martial or unarmed for weapons; unarmored, light, medium or heavy for armor.

traits.description: agile, finesse, deadly-dX, versatile-X, propulsive and two-hand-dX are read; the rest display.

hardness.description: Shields only, and display only — Shield Block reduces a flat 5 whatever this says.

heal.description: Consumable only. Drink Potion rolls this item's own formula.

boss.description: bossFlags in an encounter hit the first foe carrying this.

traits.description: The first trait naming a skill decides which skill Recall Knowledge uses.

size.description: Defaults to Medium. Decides which Athletics maneuvers reach it.

lore.description: The one line a critical Recall Knowledge prints.

reactions.description: Reaction ids the engine implements. Any other id is rejected — a reaction the engine does not have is a monster that silently never reacts.

saves.description: Modifiers for fort, ref and will.

immunities.description: mental blocks fear and hex-type conditions.

slowed.description: 1 is zombie-style: two actions a turn.

sneak.description: Companions only: precision damage against off-guard targets.

onCrit.description: Conditions applied on a critical hit.

monsterPower.description: A monster power. Used when off cooldown and at least two PCs are in radius.

cooldown.description: Rounds before it can fire again.

flavor.description: The line the Chronicle prints when it fires.

companion.description: A pre-built ally: a flat stat block the player does not forge.

subtitle.description: The line under the name on the card.

initSkill.description: The modifier the companion rolls initiative with.

saves.description: Modifiers for fort, ref and will.

companionAbility.description: A companion ability. heal is the only implemented type.

adventure.description: One adventure: a scene graph, and the encounters its scenes point at.

level.description: The level the DCs and the treasure budget are read against. No level means no budget check.

start.description: The scene the adventure opens on. It has to exist.

companionsOffered.description: Companion ids offered at a scene with companionChoice.

awards.description: Encounter id or "ending" to whole XP. Leave it out and the ending is worth a level.

scenes.description: Scene id to scene. Every one has to be reachable from start.

scene.description: One node of the narrative graph.

kicker.description: The small line above the title.

text.description: Paragraphs. The first gets the illuminated drop cap. Light HTML like <em> is allowed.

kind.description: Leave it out for an ordinary scene of prose and choices.

ending.description: An epilogue. Its flags fold into the campaign record.

gameover.description: A death. Folds nothing and pays no XP.

shopTitle.description: Shop scenes: the heading over the buy side. Defaults to "For Sale".

stock.description: Shop scenes: item ids for sale. Every one needs a price.

exploreTitle.description: Explore scenes: the heading over the cards. Defaults to "How You Go On".

choices.description: Rendered under everything else. A shop or an explore scene still needs a way out.

choice.description: One link out of a scene.

if.description: A flag expression. A leading ! negates; a name with a / reads the campaign record.

goto.description: Scene id, or END to return to the title screen.

once.description: The choice disappears after it is taken.

flagOnce.description: A flag set the first time the choice is taken.

combat.description: An encounter id of this adventure.

defeat.description: Where a lost fight goes. Defaults to a scene named "gameover".

combatLabel.description: The label over the battle button.

check.description: A one-shot skill check on a choice.

altSkill.description: The engine rolls whichever modifier is better.

dc.description: At level 3: easy 15, standard 17–18, hard 20, very hard 22.

failure.description: Scene id, or END. Branch somewhere interesting rather than dead-ending.

onEnter.description: What happens the first time the hero walks in.

flag.description: A flag set on entry. An opener flag name here is read by the next fight.

gold.description: Treasure, as a price string: "40 gp".

items.description: Item ids put in the hero's hands. Every id has to exist.

explore.description: The exploration block of a "kind": "explore" scene.

dc.description: The DC every activity here is rolled against.

goto.description: Where the hero goes once they have chosen, whatever the roll said.

activities.description: Narrows the offer, in the order written. Leave it out to offer all three.

w.description: Cells wide. Keep it to about 16.

h.description: Cells tall. Keep it to about 12.

walls.description: [x,y] pairs that block movement and line of sight.

bossFlags.description: Story flag id to {applyToBoss, log}. Effects hit the first foe whose monster is a boss.

intro.description: One line of scene-setting printed at battle start.

foe.description: One monster placed on the map.

monster.description: A monster id from this pack or already loaded.

minParty.description: Only spawns at this party size or larger.

minLevel.description: Only spawns when the hero is at least this level.

maxLevel.description: Only spawns when the hero is at most this level.

campaign.description: A run of adventures with gates on the flags the earlier ones set.

level.description: The level the campaign is written for. Shown on its card; it sets nothing.

blurb.description: Shown on the picker and at the top of the campaign board.

adventures.description: In order. The same adventure twice is rejected.

campaignEntry.description: One adventure in a campaign, in order. Always an object.

adventure.description: An adventure id defined here or already loaded.

if.description: A scoped flag expression — "earlier-adventure/some-flag". It has to name an adventure listed earlier and a flag that adventure can actually set.

locked.description: The one line the board prints over a closed road.

effect.description: One entry of the effects DSL (guide §6). Exactly one key per entry.

bonus.description: A flat numeric bonus applied at finalize.

target.description: speed, hp, initiative, perception, or save.all.

vs.description: What the bonus is against. Only speed keeps it off the flat number; every vs bonus is also collected as condBonuses.

profUp.description: Raise a proficiency if it is not already higher.

target.description: perception, save.fort, save.ref or save.will. save.all parses and does nothing.

ifSubclass.description: Substring-matched against the chosen subclass id.

trainSkill.description: A skill id, or "choice" for one more skill pick.

grantLore.description: A Lore name added to the sheet.

rank.description: The rank a grantLore is added at.

grantCantrip.description: One more cantrip pick. The tradition field is not read.

grantFeat.description: A feat id, or class-1 / general / skill for an extra slot of that kind.

sense.description: A sense added to the sheet. Cosmetic.

grantFocusSpell.description: A focus spell id — define it in spells with "focus": true.

grantFocusSpellChoice.description: Focus spell ids; the feats step renders a chooser.

focusPoints.description: Grow the focus pool. Capped at 3.

resist.description: Resistance. value is a number or the string halfLevel.

font.description: Cleric divine font: heal or harm.

special.description: An engine hook id from guide §8. Unknown ids display and do nothing.

skill.description: Which skill a {"special":"assurance"} floors. rules.js folds it into the hook id as assurance-<skill>.

condition.description: One condition applied by a spell, attack or power.

c.description: The condition id. Guide §12 lists the ones the engine does math for.

dur.description: Rounds. Omit for the standard decrement; 99 lasts the whole fight.

$comment: Written by Projects/torchbearer/tools/schema.mjs from js/schema.js. Edit the module, run `node tools/schema.mjs --write`, and commit both; test/smoke.mjs fails if they disagree.
